english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a large-scale disaster or catastrophe.
Use 災難 as the all-purpose spoken noun for a major disastrous event.
This is the all-purpose choice for a disastrous event causing great loss.
Use this when the cause of misery is a serious calamity or disaster rather than ordinary bad luck.

examples.english: Yesterday’s heavy rain flooded the whole district—it was a real disaster.
examples.traditional: 尋日場大雨搞到成區水浸，真係一場災難。
examples.jyutping: cam4 jat6 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 seng4 keoi1 seoi2 zam3 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6

examples.english: This earthquake really is a catastrophe.
examples.traditional: 呢場地震真係一場大災難。
examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 dei6 zan3 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 daai6 zoi1 naan6

examples.english: This flood was truly a calamity, and the whole village suffered heavy losses.
This earthquake brought misery to many people; it was a real disaster.
examples.traditional: 呢場地震令好多人受苦，真係一場災難。
examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 dei6 zan3 ling6 hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 fu2 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6
